summary: I wrote src/main.ts. It builds a forest with three InstancedMeshes: 8,000 trunks, 8,000 canopies (one per tree) and 2,000 rocks. Placement uses a seeded mulberry32 generator, so the forest is the same on every load. Canopies, trunks and rocks each get per-instance colours through setColorAt. The scene has one shadow-casting directional light, a hemisphere fill light, FogExp2 fog and a ground plane. The camera orbits slowly at radius 105 and height 55, which should keep the whole forest in view. I haven't built it with `vite build` or run it in a browser, so I haven't seen a rendered frame, and the framing and shadow coverage are unchecked. It passes typecheck. The render loop uses requestAnimationFrame and sets `window.__EVAL_READY__` after the first frame is drawn.
